# Formatting options reference

<!-- Generated by `npm run docs` from the formatter descriptors. Do not edit by hand. -->

These are the option names used in `codeneat.style`, in `codeneat.languages.<language>.style` and in profiles. Every option can be changed in the dashboard; you only need these names if you edit `settings.json` by hand.

An option only has an effect for formatters that support it. The dashboard disables the others and explains why.

## General Formatting

| Option (`id`) | Values | Supported by |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Line Endings** (`lineEndings`)<br>The invisible character(s) that end each line. "Keep existing" leaves each file as it is. | `auto`, `lf`, `crlf` | Prettier, Prettier for Java, Prettier for XML, Prettier for PHP, Prettier for LaTeX, Taplo (bundled), SQL Formatter, Ruff (bundled) and 32 more |
| **Format Embedded Code** (`embeddedFormatting`)<br>Also format code inside other code, such as CSS inside HTML or code blocks in Markdown. | `auto`, `off` | Prettier |

## Line Length and Wrapping

| Option (`id`) | Values | Supported by |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Preferred Line Length** (`lineLength`)<br>How many characters wide a line may be before the formatter tries to wrap it. Most formatters treat this as a goal, not a hard limit: text that cannot be split safely (long strings, URLs) may still be longer. | 40–300 (CodeNeat default 120) | Prettier, Prettier for Java, Prettier for XML, Prettier for PHP, Prettier for LaTeX, Taplo (bundled), Ruff (bundled), clang-format (bundled) and 17 more |
| **Wrap Text Paragraphs** (`proseWrap`)<br>How paragraphs of plain text (Markdown, long YAML strings) are wrapped. | `preserve`, `always`, `never` | Prettier |
| **Multi-line Objects** (`objectWrap`)<br>What happens to an object that you wrote over several lines but that would fit on one. | `preserve`, `collapse` | Prettier |
| **One Attribute per Line** (`singleAttributePerLine`)<br>Put every HTML, Vue or JSX attribute on its own line when an element has more than one. | `true`, `false` | Prettier, Prettier for XML |
| **Operators When Wrapping** (`operatorLinePosition`)<br>When a long expression is split, put the operator at the end of the first line or the start of the next. | `end`, `start` | Prettier, Prettier for Java, clang-format (bundled), shfmt (bundled), clang-format, shfmt |

## Indentation

| Option (`id`) | Values | Supported by |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Indent Using** (`indentStyle`)<br>Indent with space characters or with tab characters. | `spaces`, `tabs` | Prettier, Prettier for Java, Prettier for XML, Prettier for PHP, Prettier for LaTeX, Taplo (bundled), SQL Formatter, Ruff (bundled) and 17 more |
| **Indentation Size** (`indentSize`)<br>How many spaces one indentation level is (or how wide a tab is considered to be). | 1–16 | Prettier, Prettier for Java, Prettier for XML, Prettier for PHP, Prettier for LaTeX, Taplo (bundled), SQL Formatter, Ruff (bundled) and 22 more |
| **Continuation Indentation** (`continuationIndent`)<br>Extra indentation for the second and later lines of a statement that was wrapped. | 0–16 | clang-format (bundled), clang-format |
| **Indent Case Labels in Switch** (`indentCaseLabels`)<br>Indent "case" labels one level deeper than their "switch" statement. | `true`, `false` | clang-format (bundled), shfmt (bundled), clang-format, shfmt |
| **Wrapped Arguments in Parentheses** (`parenthesesIndent`)<br>How arguments are placed when a call or declaration does not fit on one line. | `align`, `indent`, `block` | clang-format (bundled), clang-format |
| **Indent <script> and <style> in Vue Files** (`indentScriptAndStyle`)<br>Indent the code inside the <script> and <style> blocks of a Vue single-file component. | `true`, `false` | Prettier |
| **HTML Nesting and Whitespace** (`htmlWhitespace`)<br>Whether spaces between HTML tags are meaningful. "Ignore" gives the cleanest nested indentation but may add or remove visible spaces between inline elements. | `css`, `strict`, `ignore` | Prettier |

## Spaces and Blank Lines

| Option (`id`) | Values | Supported by |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Spaces Inside Object Braces** (`bracketSpacing`)<br>Put a space after "{" and before "}" in objects and similar literals. | `true`, `false` | Prettier |
| **Space Before Opening Parenthesis** (`spaceBeforeParens`)<br>When a space is placed before "(". | `control`, `always`, `never` | clang-format (bundled), clang-format |
| **Spaces Inside Parentheses** (`spacesInParens`)<br>Put a space after "(" and before ")". | `true`, `false` | clang-format (bundled), clang-format |
| **Space Before Assignment Operators** (`spaceAroundAssignment`)<br>Put a space before "=", "+=" and other assignment operators. | `true`, `false` | clang-format (bundled), clang-format |
| **Maximum Blank Lines in a Row** (`maxBlankLines`)<br>Longer runs of empty lines are shortened to this many. | 0–10 | Taplo (bundled), SQL Formatter, clang-format (bundled), clang-format, swift-format, Taplo |
| **Blank Line Between Functions and Classes** (`separateDefinitions`)<br>Whether a blank line is added or removed between functions, methods and classes. | `leave`, `always`, `never` | clang-format (bundled), clang-format |

## Braces and Brackets

| Option (`id`) | Values | Supported by |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Opening Brace Position** (`braceStyle`)<br>Where the opening "{" of functions, classes and control statements is placed. | `attach`, `allman`, `stroustrup`, `linux`, `mozilla`, `webkit`, `gnu`, `whitesmiths` | clang-format (bundled), clang-format, PSScriptAnalyzer |
| **Closing ">" on the Last Attribute Line** (`bracketSameLine`)<br>Keep the ">" of a multi-line HTML or JSX tag on the last attribute line instead of on its own line. | `true`, `false` | Prettier, Prettier for XML |
| **Parentheses Around a Single Arrow Parameter** (`arrowParens`)<br>Whether a lone arrow-function parameter is wrapped in parentheses. | `always`, `avoid` | Prettier, Prettier for Java |
| **Short Functions on One Line** (`shortFunctionsOnOneLine`)<br>Which short functions may stay on a single line. | `none`, `empty`, `inline`, `all` | clang-format (bundled), clang-format |
| **Short "if" on One Line** (`shortIfOnOneLine`)<br>Allow a short "if" statement without "else" to stay on one line. | `true`, `false` | clang-format (bundled), clang-format |

## Quotes and Semicolons

| Option (`id`) | Values | Supported by |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Quotes** (`quoteStyle`)<br>Which quote character strings use. The formatter picks the other one when that avoids escaping. | `double`, `single`, `preserve` | Prettier, Prettier for XML, Prettier for PHP, Ruff (bundled), StyLua (bundled), Ruff, Black, PHP-CS-Fixer and 1 more |
| **Quotes in JSX Attributes** (`jsxQuoteStyle`)<br>Quote character for attribute values inside JSX. | `double`, `single` | Prettier |
| **Quotes Around Object Keys** (`quoteProps`)<br>When the keys of an object are quoted. | `as-needed`, `consistent`, `preserve` | Prettier |
| **Semicolons** (`semicolons`)<br>Whether statements end with a semicolon. Use Reset to return to the formatter default. | `always`, `never` | Prettier |
| **Trailing Commas** (`trailingCommas`)<br>Whether the last item of a multi-line list, object or parameter list is followed by a comma. | `all`, `es5`, `none` | Prettier, Prettier for Java, Prettier for PHP |

## Imports and Comments

| Option (`id`) | Values | Supported by |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Sort Imports** (`sortImports`)<br>Put import / include lines into a consistent order. This reorders lines but never adds or removes an import. | `true`, `false` | clang-format (bundled), google-java-format, Ruff, clang-format, PHP-CS-Fixer, rustfmt |
| **Remove Unused Imports** (`removeUnusedImports`) — changes code, off by default<br>Delete imports that nothing in the file uses. This changes code rather than layout, so it is off unless you switch it on. | `true`, `false` | google-java-format, PHP-CS-Fixer, ktfmt |
| **Re-wrap Long Comments** (`reflowComments`)<br>Break comments that are longer than the line length onto several lines. | `true`, `false` | clang-format (bundled), clang-format |
| **Format Documentation Comments** (`formatDocComments`)<br>Tidy documentation comments such as Javadoc, or code examples inside Python docstrings. | `true`, `false` | Ruff (bundled), google-java-format, Ruff |

## Language-Specific Options

| Option (`id`) | Values | Supported by |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **JavaScript: New Ternary Layout** (`experimentalTernaries`)<br>Use Prettier's newer layout for "condition ? a : b" chains, with the question mark at the end of the line. | `true`, `false` | Prettier |
| **Python: Trailing Comma Keeps Lists Expanded** (`pythonMagicTrailingComma`)<br>When a list or call already ends with a trailing comma, keep it one-item-per-line even if it would fit on a single line. | `true`, `false` | Ruff (bundled), Ruff, Black |
| **Java: Style Guide** (`javaStyleGuide`)<br>google-java-format implements two fixed styles. | `google`, `aosp` | google-java-format |
| **Kotlin: Style Guide** (`kotlinStyleGuide`)<br>The fixed style ktfmt or ktlint follows. | `meta`, `google`, `kotlinlang`, `android` | ktfmt, ktlint |
| **C / C++: Base Style** (`cppBaseStyle`)<br>The ready-made clang-format style that your other preferences are layered on top of. | `LLVM`, `Google`, `Chromium`, `Mozilla`, `WebKit`, `Microsoft`, `GNU` | clang-format (bundled), clang-format |
| **Rust: Edition** (`rustEdition`)<br>The Rust edition rustfmt uses to read your code when no Cargo project config is found. | `2015`, `2018`, `2021`, `2024` | rustfmt |
| **PHP: Rule Set** (`phpRuleSet`)<br>The coding standard PHP-CS-Fixer applies. | `@PSR12`, `@PER-CS`, `@Symfony`, `@PhpCsFixer` | PHP-CS-Fixer |
| **SQL: Dialect** (`sqlDialect`)<br>The SQL flavour your files are written in. | `ansi`, `postgres`, `mysql`, `mariadb`, `sqlite`, `tsql`, `oracle`, `bigquery`, `snowflake`, `redshift`, `sparksql`, `trino`, `hive`, `db2` | SQL Formatter, SQLFluff |
| **SQL: Keyword Case** (`sqlKeywordCase`)<br>How keywords such as SELECT and FROM are written. | `preserve`, `upper`, `lower` | SQL Formatter |
| **Shell: Dialect** (`shellDialect`)<br>Which shell language the script is written in. | `auto`, `bash`, `posix`, `mksh`, `bats` | shfmt |
| **Shell: Space After Redirect Operators** (`shellSpaceRedirects`)<br>Write "> file" instead of ">file". | `true`, `false` | shfmt (bundled), shfmt |
| **Shell: Function Brace on Next Line** (`shellFunctionNextLine`)<br>Put the opening brace of a function on its own line. | `true`, `false` | shfmt (bundled), shfmt |
| **Lua: Parentheses on Calls** (`luaCallParentheses`)<br>Whether calls with a single string or table argument keep their parentheses. | `Always`, `NoSingleString`, `NoSingleTable`, `None` | StyLua (bundled), StyLua |
| **XML: Whitespace in Text** (`xmlWhitespace`)<br>Whether whitespace inside elements is meaningful. "Ignore" allows real re-indentation but changes text content whitespace. | `strict`, `preserve`, `ignore` | Prettier for XML |
| **XML: Space Before "/>"** (`xmlSelfClosingSpace`)<br>Write <tag /> instead of <tag/>. | `true`, `false` | Prettier for XML |
| **XML: Sort Attributes by Name** (`xmlSortAttributes`)<br>Order the attributes of every element alphabetically. | `true`, `false` | Prettier for XML |
| **TOML: Align "=" Signs** (`tomlAlignEntries`)<br>Line up the "=" of consecutive entries in a column. | `true`, `false` | Taplo (bundled), Taplo |
| **TOML: Sort Keys Alphabetically** (`tomlReorderKeys`)<br>Reorder the keys within each table alphabetically. | `true`, `false` | Taplo (bundled), Taplo |
| **Dockerfile: Space After Redirect Operators** (`dockerfileSpaceRedirects`)<br>Write "> file" instead of ">file" inside RUN commands. | `true`, `false` | dockerfmt (bundled), dockerfmt |

## Built-in profiles

| Profile (`id`) | Description | Values |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Standard** (`standard`) | Each formatter's own recommended style with a 120 character line length. | `{"lineLength":120}` |
| **Compact** (`compact`) | Fits more code on screen: long lines, 2-space indentation, short blocks kept on one line. | `{"lineLength":160,"indentStyle":"spaces","indentSize":2,"bracketSpacing":false,"objectWrap":"collapse","arrowParens":"avoid","trailingCommas":"none","maxBlankLines":1,"shortFunctionsOnOneLine":"all","shortIfOnOneLine":true,"singleAttributePerLine":false}` |
| **Readable** (`readable`) | Roomy and easy to scan: shorter lines, 4-space indentation, one thing per line. | `{"lineLength":100,"indentStyle":"spaces","indentSize":4,"bracketSpacing":true,"objectWrap":"preserve","arrowParens":"always","trailingCommas":"all","maxBlankLines":2,"shortFunctionsOnOneLine":"empty","shortIfOnOneLine":false,"singleAttributePerLine":true,"separateDefinitions":"always"}` |
| **Team Style** (`team`) | A predictable shared baseline: 100 characters, spaces, LF line endings, single quotes and trailing commas in JavaScript, sorted imports. | `{"lineLength":100,"indentStyle":"spaces","indentSize":2,"lineEndings":"lf","quoteStyle":"single","semicolons":"always","trailingCommas":"all","sortImports":true,"maxBlankLines":1}` |

## Precedence

When an option is set in several places, the later entry wins:

1. Formatter default
2. CodeNeat default
3. Profile
4. Your settings
5. Workspace settings
6. Your settings for this language
7. Workspace settings for this language
8. .editorconfig
9. Formatter configuration file
10. Fixed by the formatter
